_doc: Process-order declarations consumed by scripts/check-chain-citation.mjs (CHAIN-CITATION-PROCESS-ORDER-1, Tim directive 2026-08-22; instrument contract J9 §0 in 0xAlpha/audits/2026-08-24-CHAIN-PROCESS-ORDER-SPECS.md). WHY A SIDECAR: assemble-chaingraph.mjs's COPY_ONLY_CHAIN_FIELDS classes ANY new top-level field on an EXISTING chain shard as a structural edit (REFUSED to a human ASSEMBLE/LAND row), so an in-shard declaration on a legacy chain would red the main-side regen (SO #47's measured failure class). New chains may declare in-shard (chain-added auto-lands); this gate accepts both surfaces and prefers the in-shard value when both exist. quote_sha256 fields are sha256 over the exact quoted string (UTF-8, no trailing newline); quoted text is byte-identical to the pinned clause snapshots at workspace-root research/clause-snapshots/. Declaring here does NOT reorder any chain's steps.

legs.process: OFAC sanctions screening and block/reject/process decision precede financing commitment or processing
legs.point_in_time: OFAC guidance as published on ofac.treasury.gov at retrieval 2026-08-29 (J9 original retrieval 2026-08-23)

order.locator: OFAC, Introduction to the Office of Foreign Assets Control, 'Internal Controls: Sanctions Screening and Scrutiny' (ofac.treasury.gov/media/935656/download)
order.quoted: If screening indicates a nexus to OFAC sanctions, an organization's compliance program should guide the organization through the following steps: 1) evaluating the screening system alert; and 2) determining whether to block, reject, or process and/or otherwise proceed with the activity.

order.locator: OFAC, A Framework for OFAC Compliance Commitments (May 2019), 'INTERNAL CONTROLS' section (ofac.treasury.gov/system/files/126/framework_ofac_cc.pdf)
order.quoted: An effective SCP should include internal controls, including policies and procedures, in order to identify, interdict, escalate, report (as appropriate), and keep records pertaining to activity that may be prohibited by the regulations and laws administered by OFAC.

legs.note: ICC UCP 600 is a copyrighted publication, not openly hosted — UNRETRIEVED-paywalled. Locator-only; never filled from memory. Future route per J9 §3: courts quote the articles as primary legal text (judicial-opinion retrieval row).
